notes: CALLER_FARMING contrast: Event-Driven Routines Engine closed an island with routine-dispatch-event CLI. That CLI is not the intended product outcome unless the frozen contract is an operator diagnostic.

semantic_contract.user_intent: On a matching business event, fire ordered routine actions through the gated workflow door.
semantic_contract.preconditions: Registered active routine; event name; company scope.
semantic_contract.state_transition: event → matching routines fire → gated workflow submit
semantic_contract.persistence_requirement: durable routine registry and run records in product form
semantic_contract.authority_requirement: same gated door as webhook/schedule triggers
semantic_contract.failure_semantics: non-matching event no-op; inactive routine skipped; malformed input fail-closed
semantic_contract.external_effect_requirement: RunWorkflow submit; other actions remain deferred
semantic_contract.user_observable_outcome: a real workflow run submitted from a live event path
semantic_contract.known_unimplemented_facets: notification/webhook transports; durable product event bus caller

facets.name: product_event_bus
evidence: CLI stdin evaluator is the shipped caller
